reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output; the rendered text is unchanged from the originals, so there is no invalid or over-reaching edit to review.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: § 13 (p0047) is a mutual, employee-only non-solicit (term plus one year) that restrains hiring rather than Customer's business lines or products, and the rule expressly treats restrictions binding the Vendor / non-compete-adjacent hiring terms as outside its scope.

§ 4 (p0020) limits Company's use of Contractor's own pre-existing proprietary materials and administrative records to the software received under the Agreement — a license-scope/background-IP term, not a field-of-use or competitive restriction on products Customer may buy, build or sell; it does not bar internal development, other vendors or acquisitions.

Rationale documents an adequate search (compete/competing, shall not, exclusiv, solicit, restrict, field of use, territory, plus scope/term/termination sections) and the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
Compliant findings are retained as internal evidence only, so the absence of a negotiation comment is correct.
